svg.title: Artifact storage evolution boundary
svg.desc: Artifact Custody identifies Artifacts by stable identity and digest and calls one storage interface. Controlled Product Data retains CPD ArtifactReferences only in Generation manifests; Product Structure and Format Intelligence keep any exact ArtifactId/digest pins inside their own Representation metadata. A filesystem adapter is the current candidate; later object or multi-volume adapters can replace it. Migration copies and verifies bytes before changing custody location records, without changing Generations or Releases.
